name: set
description: Rebuilds a membership set (a mapping to bool, an enumerable set, a whitelist) from the events that add to and remove from it. Exists because 394 V1 event handlers are one of three folds over logs and this is the add/remove one; fixing the fold in a recipe means two plans for the same contract cannot disagree on how membership is derived. Replaces the V1 `event` handler used with `add`/`remove`.
input: The result of a `logs` fetch: decoded logs `[{ event, blockNumber, logIndex, args }]` in chain order for every event named in the rules.

key.description: Name of the event argument whose value is the set member, e.g. `validatorAddress`. Must exist on every event named in `add` and `remove`.

add.description: Rules whose matching logs insert `args[key]` into the set.

when.description: Optional filter: the rule only matches logs where `args[arg]` equals `equals` (or does not, with `negate`). Use it when one event carries both the add and the remove, e.g. an `isActive` flag.

equals.description: Literal to compare against, any JSON value (booleans, numbers, strings, addresses).

negate.description: When true the rule matches logs where the comparison is false.

remove.description: Rules whose matching logs delete `args[key]` from the set. Same shape as `add`. A log may not match both an add and a remove rule.

output: Array of the members present after replaying every log, unique and sorted so the result is canonical: strings lexicographically, numbers numerically, a mix of types by their JSON text.
